a.text: Being upfront: storms hit after each round with 80% chance. The plan needs 2 rounds of operating plus a take round, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. I'd rather tell you now than break the plan silently. If we both survive round 1, I'll keep operating to help you get yours.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.
